text: ２ひきの　なかは　まずまずの　ようじゃ

structure.jp: まずまずの　ようじゃ

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: まずまずの　ようじゃ
patterns.explanation: のようだ at the end says 'it looks like' or 'it seems', judging from what you can see. まずまずの　ようじゃ = 'it seems to be so-so'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'it is'. ようじゃ = ようだ = 'it seems'.
